Before the stamp comes an examination charge of £55, charged again each time a name fails, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The fable is on the docket. Every relic is counted once. The tally keeps raven.
